audit.summary: The same-noise lower comparison is false for an admissible additive-noise example. Its noise sign can be repaired locally. The all-time convolution estimate also fails, while its short-time restriction suffices for the inspected critical doubling argument.
limitations: P1 — Counterevidence: Changing the lower equation to -sigma(-v_-) W restores the required shared coefficient for -v_-; coefficient growth and all absolute-value/square estimates are preserved.
P2 — Counterevidence: For 0<T<=1 the factorization exponents are consistent. The actual T_m=C^2*M^2*2^(-2*m+6) tends to0 at fixedM, so the proof may increase m0 to enforce T_m<=1.

proposition.claim:
The v_- defined with +sigma(-v_-) W satisfies -v_- <= u almost surely up to the positivity and explosion stopping times.

sigma identically 1, locally Lipschitz and within critical growth bound. u0 identically 0, v_-(0)=v(0)=1. alpha=4>3. Both equations driven by the same W as printed. Use intended mass-one heat semigroup; normalization typo separately recorded.

Theorem1.2 holds for every T>0 with C_p independent of T.

p>6. phi identically1, deterministic and adapted. Periodic domain [-pi,pi] with nondecaying zero mode.
